readers.name: tzkt
readers.notes: Lists FA2 and FA1.2 balances above zero.

readers.name: objkt
readers.notes: objkt indexes FA2 tokens only; every row is reported as fa2.

chain_check.method: Node RPC at chain_state.block_hash: the contract's %ledger big map, located from its own storage type, read by key hash. Key (address, token_id) -> balance > 0, or key token_id -> owner == address. A missing key is not held. A contract whose ledger cannot be located or whose layout is not one of those two is recorded as unanswerable; FA1.2 tokens are not checked. Reader lists were fetched shortly before the block was pinned (see readers[].fetched_at); a transfer in that window shows up as a disagreement.
